course_memberships_dropped_reason_requir.name: course_memberships_dropped_reason_requires_dropped_at
course_memberships_dropped_reason_requir.value: "course_memberships"."dropped_reason" IS NULL OR "course_memberships"."dropped_at" IS NOT NULL

citations_span_range_chk.name: citations_span_range_chk
citations_span_range_chk.value:
("citations"."span_start" IS NULL) = ("citations"."span_end" IS NULL)
          AND ("citations"."span_start" IS NULL
            OR ("citations"."span_start" >= 0 AND "citations"."span_end" >= 0 AND "citations"."span_start" <= "citations"."span_end"))

conversations_kind_section_chk.name: conversations_kind_section_chk
conversations_kind_section_chk.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'tutor' AND "conversations"."section_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'section' AND "conversations"."section_id" IS NOT NULL)

grades_grader_consistency_chk.name: grades_grader_consistency_chk
grades_grader_consistency_chk.value:
("grades"."graded_by_ai" = true AND "grades"."grader_membership_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("grades"."graded_by_ai" = false AND "grades"."grader_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)
